scenario: Your academic advisor, Dr. Reyes, allowed you to submit your research proposal two days after the deadline because of a family emergency. You want to thank her and reassure her that your work is on track.
subject: Thank you for the extension

tasks.description: Thank her for granting the extension.
Explain briefly how the extra time helped you.
Reassure her that the proposal is now complete and ready to submit.

exampleResponse:
Dear Dr. Reyes,

Thank you so much for allowing me extra time to submit my research proposal last week. I really appreciate your understanding during a difficult time for my family.

The additional two days made a big difference. I was able to finish gathering my sources and revise my methodology section more carefully, so the final proposal is much stronger than my first draft would have been.

I wanted to let you know that the proposal is now complete, and I will submit it through the online portal by tomorrow morning. Thank you again for your patience and support.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: Your university's environmental club is organizing a weekend beach cleanup and is looking for new volunteers. You are interested in joining but want more details before committing.
subject: Question about the beach cleanup event

tasks.description: Express your interest in volunteering for the cleanup.
Ask what time the event starts and how long it will last.
Ask whether the club provides any equipment, such as gloves or bags.

exampleResponse:
Dear Mr. Alvarez,

I saw the flyer about the beach cleanup this weekend, and I would like to take part. Outdoor volunteer work is something I really enjoy, and I think this would be a great way to get involved with the club.

Could you tell me what time the event begins and roughly how long it will run? I want to make sure I can plan my schedule around it.

I was also wondering whether the club will provide gloves and trash bags, or if volunteers need to bring their own supplies. Thank you for organizing this event, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

scenario: You ordered a textbook online for one of your classes, but it never arrived even though the tracking information says it was delivered three days ago. Classes start tomorrow and you need the book.
subject: Missing order - textbook not received

tasks.description: Explain that your order has not arrived despite the delivery confirmation.
Mention that you need the book urgently because classes start tomorrow.
Ask what options are available, such as a replacement or refund.

exampleResponse:
Dear Customer Service,

I am writing about an order that has not arrived. The tracking page shows that my textbook was delivered three days ago, but I have not received any package at my address.

This is urgent because my classes start tomorrow, and I need this textbook for the first assignment. I have already checked with my neighbors and the front desk, but no one has seen the package.

Could you let me know what options are available? I would be grateful for either a replacement shipped with express delivery or a refund so that I can purchase the book elsewhere. Thank you for your quick attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: Your economics professor mentioned in class that the department is looking for a student note-taker to support a classmate who has a documented learning disability. You are interested in the paid position.
subject: Interest in the note-taker position

tasks.description: Explain that you are interested in the note-taker position.
Mention why you would be a good fit for the role.
Ask what the next steps are to apply.

exampleResponse:
Dear Professor Whitfield,

I am writing about the note-taker position you mentioned in class today. I would like to be considered for the role.

I think I would be a good fit because I take detailed, organized notes and have not missed a single class this semester. I am also very reliable and would take the responsibility seriously, since a classmate is depending on the notes.

Could you tell me what the next steps are to apply? I am happy to provide a writing sample or meet with the department if that would help. Thank you for considering me.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You have been sick with the flu for the past four days and were unable to complete a major essay for your literature course. The paper is due tomorrow, and you want to ask Professor Andersen for a short extension so you can turn in your best work.
subject: Extension request for literature essay

tasks.description: Explain that you have been ill and could not finish the essay.
Ask for a short extension, e.g. a few days.
Reassure that you will submit as soon as possible and that it will be your best work.

exampleResponse:
Dear Professor Andersen,

I am writing because I have been sick with the flu for the past four days and was unable to finish the essay that is due tomorrow. I saw a doctor yesterday and I am only now starting to feel better.

I was wondering if it would be possible to have a short extension, perhaps two or three extra days, so that I can properly finish my analysis instead of submitting rushed work. I have already completed most of my research, but I need more time to revise my argument carefully.

I will submit the essay as soon as possible once I recover, and I promise it will reflect my best effort. Thank you for understanding, and please let me know if you need any documentation.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You are enrolled in a chemistry lab that conflicts with your part-time work schedule every Tuesday afternoon. Another lab section meets on Thursday mornings and still has open seats. You want to ask Professor Osei for permission to switch sections.
subject: Request to switch lab sections

tasks.description: Explain the scheduling conflict with your Tuesday lab.
Ask permission to move to the Thursday morning section.
Mention that the new section has open seats you confirmed.

exampleResponse:
Dear Professor Osei,

I am writing about a scheduling conflict with my chemistry lab. My part-time job now requires me to work every Tuesday afternoon, which overlaps directly with the lab session I am currently enrolled in.

I would like to ask for your permission to switch to the Thursday morning lab section instead. This time works well with my job schedule and would allow me to continue attending every session without missing any experiments.

I checked with the department office, and the Thursday section still has open seats available, so space should not be an issue. Please let me know if you approve this change or if there is a form I need to complete. Thank you for considering my request.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You are applying to graduate programs in psychology and the application deadline is in three weeks. Dr. Hassan taught your research methods course and knows your work well. You want to ask her to write a letter of recommendation.
subject: Request for a letter of recommendation

tasks.description: Ask if she would be willing to write a recommendation letter.
Mention the deadline in three weeks.
Offer to provide materials like resume or personal statement to help her.

exampleResponse:
Dear Dr. Hassan,

I hope you are doing well. I am applying to graduate programs in psychology this year, and I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to write a letter of recommendation on my behalf. Your research methods course was one of the most valuable classes I have taken, and I believe you could speak well to my analytical skills.

The application deadline is in three weeks, so I wanted to reach out with enough notice. If you are able to help, I would be truly grateful.

I would be happy to provide my resume, personal statement, and transcript, or anything else that would make writing the letter easier for you. Please let me know if you need any additional information.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: Your economics professor, Dr. Lindqvist, posted a group project assignment, but the instructions do not specify whether each member needs to submit an individual reflection or just one report per group. The deadline is next week and your group wants to start.
subject: Question about group project requirements

tasks.description: Explain that the instructions are unclear about individual vs group submission.
Ask specifically whether each member submits separately or one report per group.
Mention you want to clarify before the deadline so the group can start.

exampleResponse:
Dear Dr. Lindqvist,

I am writing about the group project you assigned last week. My group and I have read through the instructions carefully, but we are unclear about one part of the submission requirements.

Could you please clarify whether each member of the group needs to submit an individual reflection, or whether we should submit just one report per group? We want to make sure we follow the correct format before we begin working together.

Since the deadline is next week, we would like to start as soon as possible, so any clarification you can provide in advance would be very helpful. Thank you for taking the time to answer our question.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You received a lower grade than expected on your midterm exam in a statistics course. You do not understand which parts of your answers lost points and want to meet with Professor Novak during his office hours to go over the exam together.
subject: Meeting to discuss midterm exam

tasks.description: Explain you were surprised by your midterm grade and want to understand it better.
Ask to meet during his office hours.
Mention you would like to review your exam together to see where you lost points.

exampleResponse:
Dear Professor Novak,

I hope this email finds you well. I recently received my midterm exam back, and I was surprised that my grade was lower than I expected based on how confident I felt during the test.

I would like to schedule a time to meet with you during your office hours this week to better understand where I went wrong. Reviewing my mistakes would really help me prepare for the final exam.

Would it be possible to go over the exam together and discuss which sections cost me the most points? I want to make sure I understand the material correctly rather than just memorizing formulas. Please let me know which day works best for you.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: The add deadline for a popular seminar has already passed, but you found out about an open seat after a student dropped. You want to ask Professor Choudhury for permission to join the class even though the deadline has passed.
subject: Request to join seminar after add deadline

tasks.description: Explain that you missed the add deadline but a seat recently opened up.
Ask for permission to join the class late.
Reassure that you will catch up quickly on missed material.

exampleResponse:
Dear Professor Choudhury,

I am writing because I recently learned that a seat opened up in your seminar after a student dropped the course. I know the add deadline has already passed, but I was hoping you might still allow me to join.

I have been very interested in this seminar since the semester began, and I would be grateful for the chance to take it even though I missed the official enrollment window. I understand that only two weeks of material have been covered so far.

If you are willing to let me add the course, I promise to catch up quickly by reviewing the syllabus, borrowing notes from classmates, and attending your office hours if needed. Thank you for considering my request.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You have finished all the required courses in your minor and want to explore a specialized topic in urban planning that is not offered as a regular class. You want to ask Dr. Fitzgerald to supervise an independent study next semester.
subject: Proposal for an independent study

tasks.description: Explain your interest in the specialized topic not covered in regular courses.
Ask if she would be willing to supervise an independent study.
Mention you are open to designing the reading list and schedule together.

exampleResponse:
Dear Dr. Fitzgerald,

I hope you are having a good week. I have completed all the required courses for my minor, but I remain very interested in a specialized area of urban planning that is not offered as a regular class: sustainable transit design in mid-sized cities.

I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to supervise an independent study on this topic next semester. Your expertise in transportation policy makes you the person I would most value learning from.

I am happy to help design the reading list and meeting schedule together, based on whatever structure works best for your time. Would you be available to meet sometime this month to discuss the details further? Thank you for considering this opportunity.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You have been working in a research lab for one semester, but the project no longer matches your career interests in renewable energy. You want to ask your advisor, Dr. Petrov, about transferring to a different research group in the department.
subject: Interest in switching research groups

tasks.description: Explain that your current project no longer matches your interests.
Ask about transferring to a different research group focused on renewable energy.
Ask for his advice or guidance on how to make this transition smoothly.

exampleResponse:
Dear Dr. Petrov,

I wanted to reach out about my current research position. Over the past semester, I have realized that my interests have shifted more toward renewable energy, and the project I am currently working on no longer matches the direction I want to pursue.

I am interested in transferring to a research group in the department that focuses specifically on renewable energy systems. I have genuinely enjoyed developing my research skills this semester, but I feel I would grow more by working on a project aligned with my long-term goals.

Could you offer any advice on how to approach this transition smoothly, or recommend a faculty member who might be looking for students? I would appreciate your guidance before making any final decisions.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: A sudden family emergency required you to travel home unexpectedly, causing you to miss a scheduled final exam in your biology course. You want to explain the situation to Professor Mensah and ask about taking a makeup exam.
subject: Missed final exam due to family emergency

tasks.description: Explain that a family emergency caused you to miss the final exam.
Apologize for not notifying him beforehand.
Ask about the possibility of taking a makeup exam.

exampleResponse:
Dear Professor Mensah,

I am writing to explain why I was not able to attend the final exam yesterday. A sudden family emergency required me to travel home unexpectedly, and I was unable to reach the exam room or notify anyone in time.

I sincerely apologize for not contacting you in advance about my absence. The situation developed very quickly, and my focus was entirely on getting home to support my family during a difficult moment.

Now that things have settled, I wanted to ask whether it would be possible to take a makeup exam at another time that works with your schedule. I am ready to take it as soon as you are available, and I can provide documentation if needed. Thank you for your understanding.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: Your grade in a philosophy course is slightly below the threshold you need for your scholarship requirements. You noticed the syllabus does not mention extra credit, but you want to ask Ms. Kowalski, your professor, if any opportunity might be available before finals.
subject: Asking about extra credit opportunities

tasks.description: Explain your current grade is close to but below the threshold you need.
Ask if there is any extra credit opportunity available.
Mention you are willing to put in the extra work before finals.

exampleResponse:
Dear Ms. Kowalski,

I hope you are doing well. I wanted to reach out because my current grade in your philosophy course is slightly below the threshold I need to maintain for my scholarship requirements.

I noticed the syllabus does not mention any extra credit options, but I wanted to ask whether an opportunity might still be available before finals. I have really enjoyed the course material and would welcome the chance to demonstrate my understanding further.

I am willing to complete an additional essay, a reading response, or however else you feel would be fair to other students. Please let me know if this is possible, and thank you for taking the time to consider my request.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You submitted the first full draft of your senior thesis to your advisor, Dr. Larsen, two weeks ago and have not yet heard back. The final submission deadline is approaching, and you want to politely ask for feedback so you can revise in time.
subject: Following up on thesis draft feedback

tasks.description: Politely mention that you submitted the draft two weeks ago.
Ask if she has had a chance to review it and could share feedback.
Mention the deadline is approaching and you need time to revise.

exampleResponse:
Dear Dr. Larsen,

I hope you are doing well. I wanted to follow up regarding the first full draft of my senior thesis, which I submitted to you two weeks ago.

I understand you have a busy schedule, but I was wondering if you have had a chance to review it yet. Any feedback or comments you could share, even brief ones, would help me a great deal at this stage.

Since the final submission deadline is approaching, I would like to leave myself enough time to revise the chapters based on your suggestions. If it would be easier to discuss the draft in person, I would be happy to stop by during your office hours. Thank you for your guidance throughout this process.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You want to replace one of your required elective courses with a more relevant class you already completed at a summer program. The registrar's office told you that your department chair, Professor Kimura, needs to sign a course substitution form.
subject: Signature needed for course substitution form

tasks.description: Explain that you want to substitute a required elective with a course from a summer program.
Explain that the registrar's office requires his signature on the form.
Ask when you could stop by or how to get the form signed.

exampleResponse:
Dear Professor Kimura,

I am writing about a course substitution I would like to make. Last summer, I completed a course on data visualization through a summer program, and I believe it would be a more relevant substitute for one of my required electives.

The registrar's office informed me that this kind of substitution requires the signature of the department chair before it can be processed. Since you hold that role, I wanted to ask if you would be willing to review and sign the form.

Could you let me know when it would be convenient for me to stop by your office with the paperwork and the course syllabus from the summer program? I appreciate your time and help with this request.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: Your current academic advisor is retiring at the end of the semester and will no longer be available to guide your remaining coursework. You want to email the department administrator, Ms. Alvarez, to ask about the process for being assigned a new advisor.
subject: Requesting a new academic advisor

tasks.description: Explain that your current advisor is retiring and will no longer be available.
Ask about the process for being assigned a new advisor.
Mention you would like this resolved before registration for next semester.

exampleResponse:
Dear Ms. Alvarez,

I am writing because my current academic advisor has informed me that she is retiring at the end of this semester and will no longer be available to guide my coursework going forward.

Could you please let me know what the process is for being assigned a new academic advisor? I am not sure whether I need to select someone myself or whether the department will assign one automatically.

I would really appreciate it if this could be resolved before registration for next semester begins, since I will need guidance on which courses to choose. Please let me know what steps I should take or what forms I might need to complete.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You requested an official transcript from the registrar's office two weeks ago to send to a scholarship committee, but the tracking number provided still shows no updates. The scholarship deadline is in five days, and you need to follow up urgently.
subject: Delay in transcript request

tasks.description: Explain that you requested a transcript two weeks ago and it still has not been processed.
Mention the scholarship deadline in five days.
Ask for an update or expedited processing.

exampleResponse:
Dear Office of the Registrar,

I am writing to follow up on an official transcript request I submitted two weeks ago. According to the tracking number I received, the request still shows no updates, and the transcript has not yet been sent.

This is becoming urgent because the transcript needs to reach a scholarship committee within the next five days. Missing this deadline could affect my eligibility for the award, so I wanted to bring this to your attention as soon as possible.

Could you please provide an update on the status of my request, or let me know if it is possible to expedite the processing? I would be happy to provide my request number or any other information you need. Thank you for your help with this urgent matter.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: When you checked your class schedule, you noticed you were accidentally enrolled in an advanced statistics section instead of the introductory section you selected during registration. The semester starts next week, and you need this corrected before classes begin.
subject: Incorrect course section enrollment

tasks.description: Explain that you were mistakenly enrolled in the wrong section.
Clarify which section you actually selected during registration.
Ask for this to be corrected before the semester starts next week.

exampleResponse:
Dear Office of the Registrar,

I am writing because I noticed an error in my class schedule. When I checked my enrollment today, I found that I was placed in the advanced statistics section instead of the introductory section I selected during registration.

I clearly remember choosing the introductory course, since I have not yet taken the prerequisite required for the advanced level. I am concerned that being enrolled in the wrong section will put me at a serious disadvantage from the first day of class.

Since the semester starts next week, I would appreciate it if this could be corrected as soon as possible. Please let me know if you need any additional information from me to fix this, or if I should visit the office in person.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You received a merit scholarship last year, but the renewal criteria on the financial aid website seem to have changed and are unclear to you. You want to email the Office of Financial Aid to confirm what GPA and credit requirements you must meet this year.
subject: Question about scholarship renewal requirements

tasks.description: Mention that you received the scholarship last year and want to confirm renewal eligibility.
Explain the requirements on the website are unclear and ask for clarification.
Ask specifically about the GPA and credit hour requirements.

exampleResponse:
Dear Office of Financial Aid,

I am writing to ask about the renewal requirements for the merit scholarship I received last year. I want to make sure I meet all the conditions necessary to continue receiving this support.

When I checked the financial aid website, the renewal criteria seemed to have changed recently, and the wording was a little unclear to me. I was hoping you could clarify the exact requirements so that I do not risk losing the scholarship by mistake.

Specifically, could you confirm the minimum GPA I need to maintain and the number of credit hours I must complete each semester? Any additional details about the renewal process would also be very helpful. Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: As an international student, you need an updated I-20 form to apply for a summer internship that requires proof of your program end date. You want to ask the International Student Office to issue an updated document as soon as possible.
subject: Request for updated I-20 form

tasks.description: Explain that you need an updated I-20 for a summer internship application.
Specify that the internship requires proof of your program end date.
Ask how to request the updated form and how long processing takes.

exampleResponse:
Dear International Student Office,

I am writing to request an updated I-20 form. I have been offered a summer internship, and the company has asked me to provide documentation confirming my current visa status and program end date before they finalize my offer.

My current I-20 does not reflect this information clearly, so I need an updated version that shows my correct program end date as proof of status for the internship application.

Could you please let me know the steps I need to follow to request this update, and how long the processing usually takes? The internship coordinator has asked for the document within the next two weeks, so I want to make sure I submit my request in time. Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: Paying your full tuition balance in one lump sum this semester would create serious financial strain for your family. You heard that the university offers monthly payment plans and want to ask the Student Accounts Office how to enroll before the payment deadline.
subject: Inquiry about tuition payment plans

tasks.description: Explain that paying the full tuition balance at once is difficult for your family.
Ask about enrolling in a monthly payment plan.
Ask what the deadline is to sign up before late fees apply.

exampleResponse:
Dear Student Accounts Office,

I am writing because paying my full tuition balance in one lump sum this semester would create serious financial strain for my family. I understand the university offers alternative payment options, and I would like to explore them.

Could you please tell me how I can enroll in a monthly payment plan instead of paying the entire balance at once? Spreading the payments out over the semester would make a significant difference for us.

I would also like to know the deadline to sign up for this plan so that I can enroll before any late fees are applied to my account. Please let me know what documents or steps are needed to get started. Thank you for your help.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You were assigned to a triple room, but when you arrived on campus, you discovered the room only has two beds and a shared closet, making it impossible for three students to live there comfortably. You want to report this to the Housing Office right away.
recipient: Office of Housing and Residence Life
subject: Problem with triple room assignment

tasks.description: Explain that your assigned triple room only has space for two students.
Describe the specific issue such as the shared closet and limited space.
Ask for a reassignment or resolution as soon as possible.

exampleResponse:
Dear Office of Housing and Residence Life,

I am writing to report a problem with my room assignment. I was placed in a triple room with two other students, but when we arrived, we found that the room only has two beds and a single shared closet.

With three of us trying to live in this space, it has become extremely cramped and uncomfortable. There is simply not enough furniture or storage for all of us, and we are worried this will affect our ability to study and rest properly.

Could someone from your office visit the room to confirm the issue, and let us know what options are available? We would appreciate a reassignment to a proper triple room, or any other solution you can offer as soon as possible. Thank you for looking into this.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: Your financial aid was supposed to be disbursed to your student account at the start of the semester, but it still has not appeared, and you are now unable to pay for your textbooks and housing deposit. You want to contact the Office of Financial Aid urgently.
subject: Financial aid disbursement has not arrived

tasks.description: Explain that your financial aid has not been disbursed as expected.
Mention the practical problems this is causing, such as paying for textbooks and housing deposit.
Ask for an explanation and a timeline for when the funds will arrive.

exampleResponse:
Dear Office of Financial Aid,

I am writing because my financial aid was supposed to be disbursed to my student account at the start of the semester, but it still has not appeared more than two weeks later.

This delay is causing real problems for me. I am currently unable to purchase my required textbooks, and I am also behind on paying my housing deposit, which is putting my room assignment at risk.

Could you please look into why my disbursement has not gone through and provide an explanation along with a timeline for when I can expect the funds to arrive? I would appreciate any update you can share as soon as possible, since these expenses cannot wait much longer. Thank you for your attention to this urgent matter.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: Your parents' health insurance provider requires proof that you are a full-time student in order to keep you covered under their family plan. You need an official enrollment verification letter from the registrar before the insurance deadline next week.
subject: Enrollment verification letter needed

tasks.description: Explain that your insurance provider requires proof of full-time enrollment.
Ask for an official enrollment verification letter.
Mention the insurance deadline next week and ask how quickly it can be issued.

exampleResponse:
Dear Office of the Registrar,

I am writing because my parents' health insurance provider requires proof that I am currently a full-time student in order to keep me covered under their family plan.

Could you please issue an official enrollment verification letter confirming my full-time status this semester? I believe this is a standard document, but I want to make sure it includes all the details the insurance company typically asks for, such as my expected graduation date.

Since the insurance deadline is next week, I would be grateful if this could be processed quickly. Please let me know if I need to submit a formal request through the student portal or if you can send it directly. Thank you for your help with this time-sensitive matter.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You realized too late that you are struggling significantly in an advanced chemistry course due to a scheduling overload, but the deadline to drop classes without penalty has already passed. You want to ask the registrar about submitting a late drop petition.
subject: Petition to drop a course after the deadline

tasks.description: Explain that you realized too late that you needed to drop the course.
Ask about the process for submitting a late drop petition.
Briefly explain your reason, such as scheduling overload, to support the request.

exampleResponse:
Dear Office of the Registrar,

I am writing to ask about the process for submitting a late drop petition. I realized too late that I am struggling significantly in my advanced chemistry course, but by the time I understood the extent of the problem, the regular drop deadline had already passed.

This semester, I ended up with a heavier course load than I planned, and balancing five demanding classes at once has made it very difficult to keep up with the chemistry material specifically.

Could you please explain what steps I need to take to submit a late drop petition, and whether there are any forms or supporting documents I should prepare? I want to address this responsibly and appreciate any guidance you can offer.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You are transferring to a different university next semester and need your current school to send an official transcript directly to the new institution's admissions office. You want to confirm the process with the registrar before the transfer deadline.
subject: Sending official transcript to another university

tasks.description: Explain that you are transferring and need an official transcript sent to your new university.
Ask about the process and any forms needed to request this.
Ask about the timeline to ensure it arrives before the transfer deadline.

exampleResponse:
Dear Office of the Registrar,

I am writing because I am transferring to a different university next semester and need to have my official transcript sent directly to their admissions office.

Could you please explain the process for requesting this? I want to make sure I complete the correct form and provide all the necessary information, including the exact mailing or electronic address the new university requires.

I would also like to know the expected processing timeline, since the admissions office has set a firm deadline for receiving transfer documents. If there is any way to expedite the request, I would appreciate knowing about that option as well. Thank you for your help with this transition.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: You are graduating in December and want to apply for Optional Practical Training so you can work in the country after finishing your degree. You are unsure about the application timeline and want to ask International Student and Scholar Services for guidance.
subject: Question about OPT application timeline

tasks.description: Explain that you are graduating in December and want to apply for OPT.
Ask about the application timeline and when you should start the process.
Ask what documents you will need to prepare.

exampleResponse:
Dear International Student and Scholar Services,

I am writing because I am graduating this December and would like to apply for Optional Practical Training so that I can gain work experience after finishing my degree.

Since this is my first time going through the process, I am not entirely sure about the correct timeline. Could you let me know when I should start preparing my application, and how early before graduation I am allowed to submit it?

I would also appreciate knowing which documents I will need to prepare, such as recommendation forms, my updated I-20, or any specific paperwork your office requires. I want to make sure everything is submitted correctly and on time. Thank you very much for your guidance.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: After taking an introductory course, you have decided you want to change your major from biology to computer science. You want to ask your academic advising office what paperwork you need to complete and whether any of your current credits will transfer.
subject: Question about changing my major

tasks.description: Explain that you have decided to change your major from biology to computer science.
Ask what paperwork or forms you need to complete.
Ask whether your current credits will transfer toward the new major.

exampleResponse:
Dear Office of Academic Advising,

I am writing because, after taking an introductory computer science course this semester, I have decided that I want to change my major from biology to computer science.

Could you please let me know what paperwork or forms I need to complete in order to officially make this change? I want to start the process soon so it does not delay my registration for next semester.

I am also wondering whether any of the credits I have already earned in biology will count toward my new major, or whether I will need to start mostly from scratch. Any guidance you can provide about the transition would be greatly appreciated. Thank you for your help.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

scenario: A technical error on the university portal prevented you from registering for classes during your assigned time slot, forcing you to register late and receive a late registration fee. You want to ask the registrar to waive this fee since the delay was not your fault.
subject: Request to waive late registration fee

tasks.description: Explain that a technical error on the portal prevented you from registering on time.
Mention that you were charged a late registration fee as a result.
Ask for the fee to be waived since the situation was not your fault.

exampleResponse:
Dear Office of the Registrar,

I am writing about a late registration fee that appeared on my student account this semester. During my assigned registration time slot, the university portal repeatedly displayed a technical error and would not let me complete my course selections.

I tried multiple times over several hours and even contacted the help desk, but the issue was not resolved until the next day, by which point I was marked as a late registrant and charged the associated fee.

Since this delay was caused by a system error rather than anything on my part, I would like to ask whether the fee could be waived. I am happy to provide the help desk ticket number as evidence if that would be useful. Thank you for reviewing my request.

Sincerely,
